scientific_contract.chemistry_basis: Sucrose condensation structure balance: glucose + fructose - water.

goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/glucose/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_GLUCOSE_HEAVY_ATOMS.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/fructose/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_FRUCTOSE_HEAVY_ATOMS.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/water/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_WATER_HEAVY_ATOMS.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/sucrose/property/HeavyAtomCount/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.HeavyAtomCount and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_SUCROSE_HEAVY_ATOMS.json. Calculate the predicted sucrose heavy atom count using predicted_sucrose_heavy_atoms = glucose_heavy_atoms + fructose_heavy_atoms - water_heavy_atoms. Determine whether the predicted and official sucrose heavy atom scalars differ by at most 0.

required_result.producer_result: The final bounded numeric relation artifact emitted by the compiled controller plan.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch all four exact PubChem PUG REST URLs outside the Brain producer, independently parse HeavyAtomCount, recompute glucose + fructose - water, recompute absolute difference and equality predicate, and compare every consequential relation field.

freeze_note: Task scientific contract, URLs, JSON paths, formula, and threshold frozen before exact HeavyAtomCount source-value probe.
